# 11. Datalog — query ו־result

```prolog
% Datalog subset, executed by SWI-Prolog 9.2.9 with tabled reachability.
:- table reaches/2.
sensitive(patient_text).
sensitive(patient_id).
sensitive(appointment_id).
sensitive(document_id).
sensitive(medical_history).
external(appointment_system).
external(document_system).
external(instruction_system).
external(patient_channel).
flows_to(patient_text, llm_service).
flows_to(patient_id, tool_executor).
flows_to(appointment_id, tool_executor).
flows_to(document_id, tool_executor).
flows_to(medical_history, tool_executor).
flows_to(llm_service, planner_service).
flows_to(planner_service, tool_executor).
flows_to(tool_executor, appointment_system).
flows_to(tool_executor, document_system).
flows_to(tool_executor, instruction_system).
flows_to(tool_executor, patient_channel).
reaches(X, Y) :- flows_to(X, Y).
reaches(X, Z) :- flows_to(X, Y), reaches(Y, Z).
sensitive_path(D, T) :- sensitive(D), reaches(D, T), external(T).
% minimized הוא fact מפורש: אילו שדות מותר לשלוח לאיזו מערכת
minimized(patient_id,     appointment_system).
minimized(appointment_id, appointment_system).
minimized(patient_id,     document_system).
minimized(document_id,    document_system).
minimized(patient_id,     patient_channel).
allowed_external_flow(D, T) :- sensitive_path(D, T), minimized(D, T).
blocked_external_flow(D, T) :- sensitive_path(D, T), \+ minimized(D, T).
?- sensitive_path(patient_text, appointment_system).
true.
?- minimized(patient_text, appointment_system).
false.
?- blocked_external_flow(patient_text, appointment_system).
true.
?- allowed_external_flow(patient_id, appointment_system).
true.
?- blocked_external_flow(document_id, appointment_system).
true.
?- blocked_external_flow(medical_history, document_system).
true.
```

| Query | Result | ההחלטה במערכת |
|---|---|---|
| blocked_external_flow(patient_text, appointment_system) | true | אסור לשלוח את טקסט הפנייה למערכת התורים. |
| allowed_external_flow(patient_id, appointment_system) | true | השדה patient_id מותר ליעד appointment_system. |
| blocked_external_flow(medical_history, document_system) | true | אסור לשלוח היסטוריה רפואית לשום מערכת חיצונית; אין לה minimized לאף יעד, ולכן היא נחסמת בכל מסלול. |

זהו תת־סט Datalog בתחביר Prolog, שרץ ב־SWI-Prolog 9.2.9 עם tabling. קובץ build_minimized.py מייצא את minimized/2 ו־external/1 ל־OPA, כולל יעדים ללא שדות מותרים.
